hero.headline: Your best-selling dish might be losing money — in-store and on the apps
hero.subhead: MenuDesk reads your menu from a photo and tells you which dishes earn and which quietly eat your margin — and if you sell through the apps, how much more the 30% commission and VAT take.

hero.noDelivery: Works if you never touch the apps

problem.title: Growing, and still not profitable
problem.body: Ingredients are close to 63% of what a restaurant spends, and they creep up quietly every month. Customers are still careful with money, and raising prices feels like losing them. A lot of small kitchens are losing money without knowing where it goes.

points.one: Best-sellers with almost nothing left in them
points.two: Delivery-app prices that sit below break-even
points.three: A supplier raises a price and nobody notices

delivery.title: The number nobody puts through a calculator
delivery.lead: A dish that earns well in-store can lose money on every order through an app.
delivery.rowApp: On the app ฿100 — 30% commission + VAT ฿32.10 — packaging ฿5 — you keep ฿27.90
delivery.conclusion: To earn what you earn in-store, the app price has to be ฿155 — not ฿120.
delivery.note: Illustrative arithmetic · App-price checking is in development. Today MenuDesk checks your in-store margin on every dish.
delivery.ifNotOnApps: Not on the apps? Skip this section — the rest still applies in full.

step1.title: Photograph the whole menu
step1.body: Open the link and photograph every page. No signup, no login.

step2.title: AI reads the menu and estimates cost
step2.body: It reads the dish names and printed prices itself, then estimates ingredient cost from standard recipes and market prices.

step3.title: See which dishes are a worry
step3.body: Every dish ranked green, amber or red, with the price range you should be charging.

honesty.title: We give you a range, not fake precision
honesty.body: The free result is an estimate. We read your real selling prices off the menu, but costs come from standard recipes and market prices, so they can be off by roughly 30–50%. That is why every figure is shown as a range with a confidence level, labelled as an estimate.
honesty.emphasis: Trust the ranking, not the exact baht figure — precise numbers need your real recipes and your real purchase prices.

notInventory.title: This is not an inventory system
notInventory.body: Inventory systems track stuff. MenuDesk tracks money. We will not ask you to count things every day, because nobody keeps that up.

row1.label: Answers
row1.inventory: How much stock do I have?
row1.menudesk: Where is my money leaking, and what do I do?

row3.label: What happens

compatibility.title: Works with any restaurant
compatibility.body: POS or no POS. If you already have a sales system, upload a CSV export for sharper numbers. If you don't, daily totals are enough to start.
compatibility.note: No need to change the system you already use.

founder.title: Built by people who run a shop
founder.body: MenuDesk started in our own café in Korat. We used it to find our own loss-making dishes before we gave it to anyone else. It isn't software written by people who have never stood behind a counter.
